2. A part that ends with `}` but doesn't start with `{` - unmatched closing brace

For `{a b}`, PARSE_RE.split produces `['', '{a b}', '']`. Here `{a b}` is treated as a field (even though it has a space), which is valid since spaces are allowed in field names.

- `{foo}{bar` - first field OK, second unclosed -> ERROR
